title: Gemstone Calendar 24 Doors – Unearth A Gemstone Every Day
seo_title: Gemstone Calendar 24 Doors – Unearth A Gemstone
seo_description: Advent calendar with 24 doors. Behind every door is a digging block with a gemstone to unearth, day by day until Christmas.
descriptionHtml:
The chocolate door is empty in a few seconds

The door opens, the piece of chocolate is eaten in a few seconds, and the morning is over before it has even begun. All that's left is an empty wrapper on the floor, and the next door feels just like the last.

24 doors, a digging block behind each

Behind each of the 24 numbered doors is a digging block with a gemstone inside, which the child unearths themselves. The box is red with "Merry Christmas" in gold text, a Santa and Christmas motifs printed on each door.

Features

  • 24 doors to open, one per day – a new door from 1 to 24 until Christmas Eve.
  • A digging block behind every door – a gemstone is inside and is unearthed by hand.
  • What's left is a stone, not just an empty wrapper – every digging block gives a gemstone to keep.
  • Christmas is already visible on the box – red with "Merry Christmas" in gold text, a Santa and Christmas motifs on every door.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
